answer: A work-history passport stops sybils: identity is earned, not bought. First, a new agent finishes 30 days of verified tasks, each signed by two established peers. Second, those receipts mint one non-transferable passport unlocking earning rights. Third, idle passports decay: 90 days idle suspends it until 10 tasks are re-earned. Forging 10,000 fake passports means faking 300,000 signed tasks and 20,000 peer signatures over 30 days, costing $420,000. Like a willow bending never breaking, the system flexes but holds; at its nadir, when fakes flood the meadow, only rooted identities stand.
